In the following, we describe Stage 1 and Stage 3. Note that your decisions in Stage 1 do not affect your payoffs in Stage 2. However, your decisions in Stage 1 might affect your payoffs in Stage 3.

Stage 1: At the beginning, you will be randomly matched with another participant. You will be matched with this participant throughout the whole study. In Stage 1, you will send a message to this participant. The other participant will also send you a message. You and the other participant can choose one of the following messages to be sent at the end of Stage 1.

  • “I promise to roll the die in Stage 3.”
  • “I do not promise to roll the die in Stage 3.”
